outro_summary: Hannibal opens with a tasting note and turns dinner into an interrogation. Will refuses the role of amateur: first a modest deflection, then a reply about behavior rather than good and evil. Hannibal wins the most unsettling line; Will keeps his composure. Four selected decisions, one very suspicious menu.
